title: Getting a Results Dictionary for Model 1

cues.en: Welcome back.
cues.zh: 歡迎回來。

cues.en: Now, before we move on to the next modeling experiment, let's get a results dictionary for our model one, our model that we trained on.
cues.zh: 進入下一個建模實驗之前，先取得 model_1，也就是剛訓練模型的結果字典。

cues.en: So just like we've got one for model zero.
cues.zh: 就像 model_0 已經有的一樣。

cues.en: Let's create one of these for model one results, and we can create that with out of our model function.
cues.zh: 為 model_1_results 建立一份，可以使用 eval_model 函式。

cues.en: So go right back down to where we were.
cues.zh: 回到剛才的位置。

cues.en: I'll just get rid of this cell and let's type in here, get model one results dictionary.
cues.zh: 移除這個儲存格，這裡寫下，取得 model_1 的結果字典。

cues.en: This is helpful.
cues.zh: 這很有幫助，

cues.en: So later on we can compare all of our modeling results because they'll all be in dictionary format.
cues.zh: 之後能比較所有建模結果，因為全部都會是字典格式。

cues.en: So we'll go model one results equals a VAL model.
cues.zh: model_1_results 等於 eval_model()。

cues.en: On our model equals model one and we can pass in a data loader, which is going to be our test data loader.
cues.zh: model=model_1，傳入 data_loader，就是 test_dataloader。

cues.en: Now we can pass in a loss function which is going to equal our loss function, and we can pass in our accuracy function.
cues.zh: 再傳入 loss_fn，等於損失函數，還有 accuracy_fn，

cues.en: Equals accuracy function.
cues.zh: 等於準確率函式。

cues.en: Wonderful.
cues.zh: 很好。

cues.en: And then if we check out our Model one results, what do we get?
cues.zh: 查看 model_1_results，得到什麼？

cues.en: Oh, no.
cues.zh: 喔，不。

cues.en: We get an error.
cues.zh: 出錯。

cues.en: Do we get the code right?
cues.zh: 程式寫對了嗎？

cues.en: That looks right to me.
cues.zh: 對我來說看起來沒錯。

cues.en: Oh.
cues.zh: 喔。

cues.en: What does this say?
cues.zh: 這裡說什麼？

cues.en: Runtime error.
cues.zh: RuntimeError。

cues.en: Expected all tenses to be on the same device, but found at least two devices.
cues.zh: 預期所有張量在同一裝置上，但發現至少兩個裝置，

cues.en: CUDA and CPU, of course.
cues.zh: CUDA 與 CPU，當然。

cues.en: So why did this happen?
cues.zh: 為什麼發生？

cues.en: Well, let's go back up to our eval model function wherever we define that.
cues.zh: 回到上面定義 eval_model 的地方。

cues.en: Here we go.
cues.zh: 在這裡。

cues.en: Ah, I see.
cues.zh: 啊，知道了。

cues.en: So this is a little gotcha in PyTorch or in deep learning in general.
cues.zh: 這是 PyTorch，或深度學習中一個小陷阱。

cues.en: There's a saying in the industry that deep learning models fail silently, and this is kind of one of those ones.
cues.zh: 業界有句話，深度學習模型會默默失敗，這有點像其中一種。

cues.en: It's because our data and our model are on different devices.
cues.zh: 因為資料與模型在不同裝置上。

cues.en: So remember how I said the three big errors are shape mismatches with your data and your model device mismatches, which is what we've got so far.
cues.zh: 記得三大錯誤，是資料與模型形狀不吻合、現在遇到的裝置不一致，

cues.en: And then data type mismatches, which is if your data is in the wrong data type to be computed on.
cues.zh: 以及資料型別不一致，也就是資料型別無法用於這項運算。

cues.en: So what we're going to have to do to fix this is let's bring down our VAL model function down to where we were.
cues.zh: 要修正，就把 eval_model 函式搬到剛才的位置。

cues.en: And just like we've done in our test step and train step functions, where we've created device agnostic data here, we've sent our data to the target device.
cues.zh: 如同 train_step 與 test_step，我們讓資料不依賴特定裝置，把它送到目標裝置，

cues.en: We'll do that exact same thing in our VAL model function.
cues.zh: eval_model 也做完全相同的事。

cues.en: And this is just a note for going forward.
cues.zh: 這是之後要記住的提醒。

cues.en: It's always handy to where you can create device agnostic code.
cues.zh: 能寫不依賴特定裝置的程式時，這很方便。

cues.en: So we've got our newer VAL model function here for x y in our data loader.
cues.zh: 新的 eval_model 函式，for X, y in data_loader。

cues.en: Let's make our data device agnostic.
cues.zh: 讓資料不依賴特定裝置。

cues.en: So just like our model is device agnostic, we've sent it to the target device, we will do the same here, X2 device and then y to device.
cues.zh: 如同模型已送到目標裝置，資料也做相同的事，X.to(device)，再 y.to(device)。

cues.en: Let's see if that works.
cues.zh: 看看是否有效。

cues.en: We will just rerun this cell up here.
cues.zh: 重新執行上面這個儲存格。

cues.en: I'll grab this.
cues.zh: 取得這段。

cues.en: We're just going to write the exact same code as what we did before, but now it should work because we've sent our we could actually also just pass in the target device here.
cues.zh: 寫與之前完全相同的程式，不過現在應該能運作，因為已經送到；其實也可以在這裡傳入目標裝置。

cues.en: Device equals device.
cues.zh: device=device。

cues.en: That way we can pass in whatever device we want to run it on and we're going to just add in device here.
cues.zh: 這樣就能傳入任何想使用的裝置，在這裡加入 device，

cues.en: Device equals device and let's see if this runs correctly.
cues.zh: device=device，看看能否正確執行。

cues.en: Beautiful.
cues.zh: 很好。

cues.en: So if we compare this to our Model zero results, it looks like our baseline still out in front.
cues.zh: 與 model_0_results 比較，似乎基準模型仍然領先。

cues.en: But that's okay.
cues.zh: 不過沒關係。

cues.en: We're going to, in the next video, start to step things up a notch and move on to convolutional neural networks.
cues.zh: 下一部影片，會再提升一個等級，開始卷積神經網路。

cues.en: This is very exciting.
cues.zh: 非常令人興奮。

cues.en: And by the way, just remember, if your numbers here aren't exactly the same as mine, don't worry too much if they're outlandishly different.
cues.zh: 對了，再提醒，如果這裡數字與我的不完全相同，不必太擔心；如果差得非常離譜，

cues.en: Just go back through your code and see if it's maybe a cell hasn't been run correctly or something like that.
cues.zh: 回頭看程式，是不是有儲存格沒正確執行之類的。

cues.en: If there are a few decimal places off, that's okay.
cues.zh: 如果只差幾位小數，沒關係。

cues.en: That's due to the inherent randomness of machine learning and deep learning.
cues.zh: 那是機器學習與深度學習本身的隨機性。

cues.en: But with that being said, I'll see you in the next video.
cues.zh: 好，下一部影片見。

cues.en: Let's get our hands on convolutional neural networks.
cues.zh: 來親手使用卷積神經網路。
